title: Agreement through a position
statement: Given Boolean sequences $A$, $B$, and $C$, define agreement through position $0$ to be true. At position $i+1$, agreement holds exactly when it holds through position $i$ and the sum bit of $A$ and $B$ at position $i$ equals $C_i$.
